newsitem.title: UK: LEICESTER RUGBY CLUB PLANS CONVERSION TO PLC.
newsitem.headline: LEICESTER RUGBY CLUB PLANS CONVERSION TO PLC.

text.p: Rugby union club Leicester Football Club Ltd said on Monday it planned to convert to a public limited company (PLC).
The club, known as the Tigers and one of English rugby's most dominant forces in recent years, said the conversion was the first stage of a process to put the club on a stronger financial basis.

"I believe that conversion to public company status will put us in a position to exploit new sources of finance and further enhance the status of the Leicester Tigers," said chief executive Peter Wheeler. Conversion to Plc status requires approval from the club's members at two separate general meetings.
